jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Sales Development Representative

Location: Turkey (Remote)

Cambly is one of the largest online English language platforms in the world, backed by top-tier investors like Bessemer and Benchmark. We help thousands of people improve their English and proudly partner with hundreds of the world’s most prestigious companies to empower their teams with language skills for global success.

We're looking for highly motivated, organized, and results-driven SDRs to be a core part of our 2026 success story and beyond in the dynamic Turkish B2B market.

Why Join Cambly?

Your experience at Cambly will be a true career accelerator where you'll gain crucial skills and build an invaluable network.

  • High-Impact Role: You'll be tackling a critical challenge for Learning & Development teams making a tangible difference in organizational success.

  • Career Growth: Work directly with experienced sales leaders and utilize the latest sales technology.

  • Premium Network: Build relationships and network with prestigious HR and procurement teams across the Turkish market.

  • Culture: An employee-first working culture focused on results, no unnecessary stress or nonsense.

The Role

As our SDR, you'll play the crucial role of breaking into new accounts and fostering relationships within our target customer segments in Turkey. You understand that this is one of the most vital roles in the company, directly impacting the bottom line by creating the initial pipeline. Day-to-day, you'll collaborate closely with the wider sales team, conduct market research, and qualify leads by learning about their approach to language education.

Responsibilities

  • Drive New Business Growth: Execute targeted, outbound prospecting and account penetration strategies to generate qualified sales opportunities.

  • Qualify and Nurture Leads: Engage and develop leads (inbound and outbound) through multi-channel outreach including social selling, cold calls, email sequences, and event follow-up.

  • Master the Lead Lifecycle: Identify and develop an in-depth understanding of the lead generation process, supporting marketing activities and ensuring a seamless, qualified handoff to an Account Executive.

  • Diligently Follow Up: Conduct persistent follow-up calls and emails until meetings are successfully set.

  • Contribute to Sales Strategy: Share valuable market insights and help build out our world-class Sales Playbook and Tech Stack by learning from our well-seasoned sales team.

Qualifications

Must-Haves

  • Native in Turkish and fully proficient in English (C1/C2 level) for clear business communication.

  • 2 years of proven experience in a Sales Development, BDR, or similar outbound commercial role.

  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding targets in a quota-carrying role.

  • Experience working directly with B2B clients in the Turkish market.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills. You have a way with words and can write compelling email copy and sequence campaigns that convert.

  • Experience with CRM systems and sales engagement tools

  • Experience working with HR & Learning Development teams or for a learning, e-learning, HR software, or wellbeing company.

Skills & Mindset

  • A self-motivated, results-driven, and entrepreneurial spirit with a strong growth mindset.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to work autonomously and self-source solutions.

  • Active relationship builder who can collaborate effectively with internal and external teams to consistently improve processes and communication.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and remote team environment.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Prior experience working at a fast-growing startup.

  • Previous experience working in a remote & distributed team.

Some things you will enjoy

  • Financial & Growth: Competitive salary, a fair commission system, and a professional development budget.

  • Time & Flexibility: Remote work, and paid time off available from your first month.

  • Comprehensive Care: Supplementary private health insurance provided.

  • Mental Health: Access to Modern Health, offering 6 free coaching and 6 free therapy sessions.

  • Allowances: Dedicated lunch and internet allowances.

  • Team: A truly global team.

Interested? Applying is simple: just click 'Apply' and upload your CV to get started.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Staff Software Engineer

About Cambly: Our mission is to bring high-quality English education to every English learner in the world at the touch of a button. Think of us as the Airbnb that matches English students with English tutors. Come help us build the world's largest English learning marketplace and school.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to own the technical direction of the products we ship. You'll be a senior technical owner on a fast-moving engineering team of around 15 engineers: backend-strong, comfortable working across the stack, and accountable for taking products from design through launch. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers, and you'll set the bar for how the team builds.

We're bringing AI to language learning in a way that strengthens what makes Cambly work: real tutors and real human connection. And we build AI-first: implementation is delegated to AI coding tools so engineers spend their time on the decisions, design, and review that actually shape the product. That's how you work too.

Our frontend is built on Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Our backend is built with Python (Flask and FastAPI) on AWS with MongoDB.

You will

  • Own the product platform. Lead the design and delivery of our backend systems: APIs, data models, and services, and be accountable for them working in production.

  • Make the hard calls. Own the judgment that shapes product work, including how we model the domain and when to build for scale and extensibility versus building quickly for fast learnings.

  • Ship end to end. Take products from technical design through launch, and own major initiatives across the team.

  • Work across the stack. Pick up frontend, mobile, and data work outside your core when a product needs it, using AI to be effective in areas where you aren't the resident expert.

  • Set how we build. Raise the technical bar through architecture, reviews, and good practices, and turn the AI workflows that work into practices the rest of the team adopts.

  • Grow the team. Mentor engineers, review their work, and help raise the standard of everyone around you.

Work on projects like

  • Owning the platform behind a new AI-forward learning experience that generates personalized activities for each learner, and shaping it as we learn what works.

  • Designing the backend systems and data models that hold up as an AI-forward product grows.

  • Building post-lesson activities curated to each learner's areas for improvement.

About you

  • 7+ years of engineering experience, with a track record of owning systems and leading them to production.

  • Deep backend ability: API design, data modeling, and production systems that hold up at scale.

  • You build AI-first. Directing AI coding tools to do the implementation, and spending your own time on decisions and review, is already how you work, not something you're curious to try.

  • You own your work and have the technical judgment to make the calls that come with it, including when to invest in scale and extensibility and when to optimize for speed and learning.

  • Comfortable working outside your core. You'd rather pick up unfamiliar parts of the stack and ship than wait for a specialist.

  • A product mindset. You care about shipping things learners actually use.

  • A clear communicator who can explain technical trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers alike.

Life at Cambly includes

  • $60M VC backed. Check out why Bessemer invested in us.

  • Hybrid first company. Office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

  • Daily catered lunch.

  • 100% of medical, dental, and vision paid, along with 401k matching up to 4%.

  • Maternity and paternity paid leave.

  • 20 days of PTO, 9 days of sick leave, 10 company holidays, plus an end-of-year shutdown.

  • Helping people around the world unlock economic opportunities by learning English.

Compensation

This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, and the expected base salary range for this position is shown below. The actual base pay depends on job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, business needs, and market demand, so in some circumstances the actual salary could fall outside this range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits.

$200,000 - $230,000 USD Base Salary plus pre-IPO stock options.


Equal opportunity

We are proud to be a highly inclusive company and an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We believe that in order to thrive, businesses need a diverse team and leadership. We welcome every background, identity, ability, and mindset to join us on our mission to make high-quality English education available to all. Everyone is welcome here.

jobs.title: CRM Program Manager - Brazil (contract - remote)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
CRM Program Manager (contract - remote)

Team: Consumer Marketing

Reports to: Head of Consumer Marketing

Level: Manager (program-level ownership)

About Cambly

Cambly is a global language learning platform that connects learners with tutors for real conversation practice, supported by AI-powered learning tools. We help students around the world build confidence and fluency in English.

About the Role

We're looking for a CRM Program Manager to lead Cambly's customer relationship management strategy and execution — delivering the right message to the right customer at the right time, via the right channel. This is a global role covering Cambly's markets across Latin America, Europe/Middle East, and Asia. You will run one CRM strategy with market-specific channel and messaging execution. You'll own CRM across email, in-app, push, and messaging apps, including expansion into local chat platforms such as WhatsApp, WeChat, and KakaoTalk.

This role combines strategic program management, cross-functional leadership, and CRM platform expertise to drive acquisition, engagement, and retention based on deep analysis of user behavior. You'll own the CRM roadmap, platform strategy, audience strategy, deliverability health, major CRM initiatives (including AI integrations), and performance measurement across regions. You'll partner with creative, growth, product, data, engineering, and regional teams, and work closely with operational specialists who execute day-to-day campaign setup.

What You'll Do

CRM Strategy & Program Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end CRM strategy across email, in-app, push, and messaging apps, aligned to acquisition, engagement, and retention KPIs.

  • Build and maintain the CRM roadmap, balancing evergreen lifecycle programs, promotional campaigns, and strategic initiatives.

  • Own the messaging-app channel strategy by market: WhatsApp (e.g., Brazil, Turkey, Arabic-speaking markets), WeChat (China), KakaoTalk (Korea), and other local platforms as markets warrant. Lead each from evaluation and pilot through rollout.

  • Set the global CRM framework and define what can be localized by market (channel mix, timing, offers, tone) and what stays standard.

  • Serve as the single point of accountability for CRM outcomes and leadership reporting.

CRM Platform & Vendor Management

  • Evaluate and manage messaging providers and official business account setups per platform (e.g., WhatsApp Business API providers, WeChat Official Accounts, KakaoTalk business channels), including template approvals and platform policy compliance.

  • Own platform relationships (e.g., Iterable), including contracts, roadmap alignment, feature adoption, and renewals.

  • Drive strategic CRM innovation projects, such as AI/LLM integrations with the CRM stack, from discovery through rollout and measurement.

  • Identify gaps across the CRM stack and champion investments that reduce cost, improve efficiency, or unlock new capabilities.

Audiences & Lifecycle Journeys

  • Partner with PMs and engineers to co-design lifecycle programs, in-product messaging surfaces, event instrumentation, and journey delivery mechanics.

  • Define audience segmentation and lead qualification frameworks — who we reach, via which channel, and at which lifecycle stage.

  • Own audiences and lists across markets: segmentation, hygiene, suppression, and ongoing maintenance.

  • Develop customer journey and audience insights that improve profitability, delivery, and engagement.

  • Design and oversee automated journeys, personalization, and experimentation standards (subject lines, send times, cohorts, journey structures), including promotional updates.

Analytics, Measurement & Optimization

  • Own CRM KPIs, dashboards, and reporting across all channels.

  • Report CRM performance by market and channel, with cross-market comparisons in the WBR.

  • Own email deliverability health (bounces, spam complaints, warming, IP/domain reputation), partnering with engineering and ESPs.

  • Design and lead CRM experiments and turn learnings into durable program improvements.

  • Tie CRM performance to business outcomes (LTV, retention, activation, payback) with actionable recommendations.

Cross-Functional Program Management

  • Lead planning, execution, and retros for major campaigns (promotions, product launches, regional initiatives).

  • Partner with product and data teams to make every initiative measurable end-to-end — event tracking, data pipelines, attribution, and metric integrity.

  • Coordinate workstreams across marketing, product, engineering, data, and regional stakeholders.

  • Document CRM processes, playbooks, and standards so execution is repeatable.

  • Secure creative resourcing before committing to timelines; write clear creative briefs, and step in on messaging and copy when needed.

AI, Automation & Innovation

  • Automate reporting, monitoring, and manual workflows using AI, scripts, and no-code/low-code tools.

  • Use AI to deliver high-quality, culturally accurate localization and scale content without sacrificing brand voice.

  • Lead AI adoption within CRM — personalization, copy generation, segmentation, and journey optimization — and share learnings across marketing.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing, ideally at a consumer subscription, mobile, or edtech company.

  • Hands-on expertise with a modern CRM/ESP platform (e.g., Iterable, Braze, Customer.io), including journey building and segmentation.

  • Proven track record owning CRM strategy and roadmap with measurable impact on acquisition, engagement, and retention.

  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable with dashboards, experimentation, and SQL or similar tools.

  • Working knowledge of email deliverability best practices.

  • Experience running multi-market or international CRM programs; familiarity with messaging apps like WhatsApp, WeChat, or KakaoTalk is a plus.

  • Excellent cross-functional program management and stakeholder communication skills.

  • Strong writing skills and the ability to brief creative teams or draft copy directly.

  • Curiosity and hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve marketing workflows.

What Success Looks Like

  • CRM is a clearly defined, strategically led function with a published roadmap and measurable impact.

  • Audiences are well segmented and maintained; deliverability is strong and proactively managed.

  • CRM is meaningfully expanded onto local chat platforms, driving incremental engagement and revenue.

  • Journey and audience insights drive higher-profitability segments and better engagement — not just more sends.

  • CRM results are clearly and consistently represented in the Weekly Business Review.

  • Product, data, and engineering see CRM as a true technical partner — every initiative is instrumented from day one.

  • The CRM stack is used to its full potential, and major initiatives are delivered end-to-end.

  • Manual workflows are increasingly automated, and AI powers high-quality localization and content at scale.
